decisions.reason: Although somewhat more peripheral than core hosting, it fits the firm's push into compliance for agencies and its continued dedicated page plus at least some positive market signal suggest performance is likely near aspiration and worth carrying under available slack.

As a homepage-featured platform product in both years that directly extends the firm's core hosting capabilities and strategic direction, it is very likely above aspiration or strategically important enough to retain.

This configurable managed hosting plan is close to the established offer, remained on its own page across both years, and in a growing industry a German hosting firm would normally keep such a core adjacent product unless results were clearly disappointing.

Despite being newer and less visibly established, extended PHP security support strongly matches the firm's security and compliance positioning, so boundedly rational management would likely continue it while learning more rather than drop it quickly.
